text.p: French President Jacques Chirac and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, who are scheduled to meet on Saturday, have added a new rendezvous for next Tuesday, Chirac's office said on Wednesday.
The meeting in Paris on December 3 will be a working session ahead of a full-blown Franco-German summit in Nuremberg on December 9 and a European Union summit in Dublin on December 13-14.
The Saturday meeting will take place at Perigeux, southwest France, where Kohl's wife Hannelore is due to be awarded a prize for a cookbook she wrote which is a best-seller in Germany.
Chirac and his wife will travel to Perigeux specially for the event.
